A replica of the one $$アムロ・レイ$$ built during the $$一年戦争$$. $$バナージ$$ received it as a gift in childhood from the father whose face he cannot even remember. The fad for them has passed, so few people still have one, but $$バナージ$$ has made his own modifications to his and carries it everywhere.

fixes.new:
A student at the $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス工業専門学校$$. 16 years old.
$$バナージ$$'s classmate.
A bit of a joker, he is also a huge mobile suit enthusiast. His knowledge is extensive, covering everything from the Zaku to the Federation's new $$リゼル$$.
He aims to become an $$アナハイム$$ test pilot or mechanic someday, and even after being taken aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$, he kept his positive attitude, helping out with mechanic work, and at times even took up a gun together with $$ミコット$$ to stand against the $$袖付き$$.
His extensive mobile suit knowledge proved useful in improving the $$ユニコーン$$, and contributed greatly to giving the $$ユニコーン$$ its Full Armor conversion.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: 少しお調子者 = someone who easily gets carried away / a joker; 'flake' means unreliable, which the Japanese does not say

fixes.new:
An executive of the lunar conglomerate $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$. Age 33.
His father is $$カーディアス・ビスト$$, head of the $$ビスト財団$$, making him $$バナージ$$'s older half-brother.
He is weak-willed and prone to petty scheming, and harbors a complex toward the father who never paid him any attention. $$マーサ$$ has exploited that weakness in his heart and uses him as her lapdog.
At the wish of $$マーサ$$, who wants to prevent the disclosure of '$$ラプラスの箱$$', he boards the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$.
He infiltrates $$インダストリアル７$$ together with the $$エコーズ$$, and though he manages to restrain $$カーディアス$$ once, he ends up shooting him in the heat of the moment.
He continues to remain aboard the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ afterward, trying to take control of the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$. At the same time, he comes to view $$バナージ$$, to whom his father $$カーディアス$$ entrusted the $$ユニコーン$$, as an enemy.
Later, having had his life saved by $$マリーダ$$, he became obsessed with her. After $$マリーダ$$ died at the hands of the $$バンシィ$$ he had entrusted to $$リディ$$, he was guided by $$マリーダ$$ to reject $$マーサ$$ and part ways with her.
After $$ラプラスの箱$$ was disclosed and the colony laser was stopped by the Psycho-Field, he admonished $$マーサ$$, who was still trying to struggle in vain, with a calm expression.
fixes.reason: mistranslation: 開示を阻止したいマーサの意向で - it is Martha who wants to prevent the disclosure (意向 = wish, not orders); the English made Alberto the one who wants it

fixes.new:
$$カーディアス・ビスト$$'s younger sister. Age 55.
She married into the $$カーバイン家$$, relatives of $$アナハイム$$'s chairman, and is a formidable woman whose business acumen surpasses her husband's.
She schemes to keep the secret of '$$ラプラスの箱$$' intact, thereby maintaining its existence and, by extension, the $$ビスト財団$$'s prosperity, and she set her nephew $$アルベルト$$ in motion to facilitate the murder of $$カーディアス$$, who intended to disclose the box.
Afterward she continues to scheme to obtain the $$ユニコーン$$, using her power to set various plots in motion.
When $$ラプラスの箱$$ was about to pass into the hands of $$バナージ$$ and the others, she and $$ローナン$$ planned to burn it away with the colony laser '$$グリプス２$$'. But the fired laser was stopped by the $$ユニコーン$$ and the $$バンシィ$$, and her scheme failed.
After $$ラプラスの箱$$ was disclosed, she tried to brazen it out and struggle on, but was admonished by $$アルベルト$$ and taken away by $$ブライト$$ and the others.
fixes.reason: omission + mistranslation: その存在を維持し (maintain the box's existence) was missing; and 殺害を手引きした has Martha as the one who guided/facilitated the killing, while the English had Alberto arranging it

A highly skilled pilot raised on the Moon, called 'a genius of space combat'.
Prone to sharp emotional swings, she challenged $$カズミ$$, who had only just come up into space, to a duel, and then treated $$カズミ$$ warmly once the duel was over.
She is thoroughly strict about fighting, and once even wrote off $$ノリコ$$, who was on the verge of being crushed by fear.

Afterward, she fought the Space Monsters aboard the $$シズラー$$ and made it back alive.

The oldest of the $$メガネビュラ$$ $$トップレス$$ and a leader-like presence among them.
He prefers a fighting style of directing others, and sometimes gave orders from the control room without boarding a Buster Machine.

fixes.new:
The youngest active $$トップレス$$ of $$フラタニティ$$, belonging to $$メガネビュラ$$. 13 years old.
She is moody and sensitive in the way children are, but acts cynical as if to hide it.
When $$ノノ$$ first came to $$メガネビュラ$$, $$チコ$$ openly showed rivalry toward $$ラルク$$ and was fixated on the Space Monster kill score.
She excels at precognition and communication abilities, and in one scene talked with $$ラルク$$, who was on Mars, through a cat.
At first she piloted $$ソワサンシス$$, but lost it in a battle with the $$木星急行$$. Later, in another battle with the $$木星急行$$, she was chosen by $$キャトフヴァンディス$$ and became its pilot.
In early childhood, despite having $$トップレス$$ ability, she could not save a boy she had feelings for from illness; this remained a regret, and she came to dislike the $$トップレス$$ ability. The earrings she wears are a keepsake of that boy: they were originally not earrings at all but the parts meant to be the eyes and mouth of a snowman.
After overcoming the emotional wound of childhood on Jupiter, her prickly attitude toward those around her subsided, and she came to watch over $$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ as a good friend to both.
Ten years after the final battle, she is depicted setting out as a space pilot, escorting a diplomatic delegation to Sirius.
fixes.reason: pro-drop: subjects dropped although the entry is about Tycho (female); in the Nono clause the name is kept to avoid 'she' reading as Nono | pro-drop/pronoun/addition: subjects restored and the repeated name replaced by 'she' (Tycho is female); 'fatal' is not in the source (病魔から救う = save from illness, no death stated); 'those around Tycho' -> 'those around her' (周囲 of herself) [token occurrences intentionally replaced by a pronoun: $$チコ$$ x6]

fixes.new:
One of '$$サーペンタインの双子$$', who belong to the northern base $$ケンジントン$$ of the $$辺境星区$$ and are the organizers of the secret circle '$$蛇の沼$$'. Claims to be 18, but her true age is unknown.
She is the older sister of the twins; $$ルクルト$$ is the younger sister.
A rare type of $$トップレス$$ whose abilities manifest as twins, she schemes in pursuit of 'a $$トップレス$$ that lasts forever'.
As part of human experiments to preserve $$トップレス$$ ability, the flesh of the $$タイタン変動重力源$$ was eaten under the name 'Titan crab'.
The secret circle's members and collaborators are everywhere, from the government of the imperial capital to corporations and the business world, think tanks at universities and research institutes, and even the Space Force, and the Buster Machine '$$カランドゥ$$' that the twins ride, which is originally sealed away, is used as a special exception through that circle's political power.
Believing the variable gravity source sleeping on Titan to be an 'alien $$トップレス$$', she took the post of general chair of the operation to excavate it. She carried out the revival of the variable gravity source, but it ended in an ironic result: both of the twins were killed by the attack of the revived variable gravity source.
fixes.reason: pro-drop: 変動重力源の蘇生を行うも - the same subject who took the post of chair carried out the revival; the passive hid the agent

The hired manager of 'Lakeside Diner's' ($$レイクサイド・ダイナーズ$$), a cheap diner near Mars Spaceport No. 6, who took in the runaway $$ノノ$$ as a live-in employee.
Her real name is '$$グランディネ・アルガローリング$$'.
A realist whose dream of becoming a singer came to nothing, and who took a sincere interest in $$ノノ$$, who did nothing but dream.
She has had the shop's utensils, dishes and even the refrigerator broken by $$ノノ$$, and records the resulting debt in a notebook.
She found it odd that $$ノノ$$ could split even a refrigerator clean in two, but never realized to the end that $$ノノ$$ was an android.

fixes.new:
The vocalist and bassist of Fire Bomber.
She is honest, cheerful, and full of curiosity. At an age where she wants to seem more grown-up, she dislikes being treated like a child, though her thinking is still age-appropriate, and she can be seen acting on emotion and impulse.
Her parents are the genius Max and the ace Milia, and she has considerable skill and nerve as a pilot in her own right.
The free-spirited $$バサラ$$ always leaves her irritated, but she openly acknowledges his singing. She is also interested in him romantically, though she has yet to take the first step. At the same time, she has feelings for $$ガムリン$$, whom she met through an arranged meeting and who proposed to her before the showdown with the Protodeviln, but neither relationship appears to have progressed.
She could not stop thinking about $$バサラ$$, who had left on a journey without saying where he was going, and remained distracted, but with a push from Ray she set off for the planet Zola.
fixes.reason: omission: どちらとの仲も発展していない模様 - the hedge 模様 (it appears) was dropped

A pure-blooded Zentradi woman who plays drums for Fire Bomber.
She boasts the superhuman strength typical of the Zentradi, along with astonishing eyesight of 7.2.
She is extremely taciturn, and is always tapping something with her drumsticks.
She hides a burning passion within her, and in the showdown with the Protodeviln her drumming generated Song Energy.
fixes.reason: addition: the Japanese says ドラミングによって歌エネルギーを生み出した (produced Song Energy through drumming); 'helped' is not in the source

fixes.new:
The captain of Diamond Force, an elite unit of the $$マクロス７$$ fleet. His rank is captain.
Being a serious person to the core, he did not think well of $$バサラ$$ singing on the battlefield when they first met. But through the fighting he was touched by $$バサラ$$'s passion, and he has now become someone who understands $$バサラ$$ well.
Through his interactions with $$バサラ$$, $$ミレーヌ$$ (whom he met through an arranged meeting) and the others, his rigid personality softened somewhat, but his hopelessness with women remained unchanged. His relationship with $$ミレーヌ$$, whom he even proposed to before the showdown with the Protodeviln, does not seem to have made any notable progress since.
Worried about $$ミレーヌ$$, who could no longer concentrate on her singing over $$バサラ$$, who had left on a journey without saying where he was going, he headed to the planet Zola to bring him back.
fixes.reason: mistranslation/omission: 良き理解者 = a good person who understands him, not a 'supporter' (and 'one of' is an addition); ミレーヌ達 - 'and the others' was dropped

fixes.new:
A $$プロトデビルン$$ in the form of a handsome man.
That body is that of Staff Officer $$イワーノ・ギュンター$$ of the U.N. Spacy, who lost to his own ambition.
He is absolutely supported by every $$プロトデビルン$$ other than $$ギギル$$ and $$シビル$$, showing signs of great charisma.
He is in a position to command the other $$プロトデビルン$$ and the $$バロータ軍$$, and rarely steps outside the flagship.
Even in the provisional body, his Spiritia absorption ability exceeds that of the other $$プロトデビルン$$, and he tormented $$バサラ$$ through the bridge. He can also radiate a Spiritia stream from his entire body, and also possesses the ability to transfer others.
To avoid repeating the past failure of Spiritia depletion, he planned the 'Spiritia Farm Project' and attacked the $$マクロス７$$ fleet and other emigrant fleets.
The true body possesses a Spiritia absorption ability that could be called a black hole of Spiritia, and continued to absorb Spiritia from the entire $$マクロス７$$ fleet.
In the end, inspired by $$バサラ$$, he sang 'TRY AGAIN' and evolved into a race that regenerates Spiritia by itself. Afterward he flew off to another galaxy with $$ガビグラ$$ and $$シビル$$. The form at that time was a human-sized one based on $$イワーノ・ギュンター$$.
fixes.reason: pro-drop/pronoun: Gepelnitch is male (美形の男性の姿, wiki, library_characters); subjects dropped or 'it' used

fixes.new:
A girl-type $$プロトデビルン$$ revived by the hand of $$ギギル$$.
She is human-sized, but capable of driving a U.N. Spacy fleet to destruction.
She is taciturn, but very curious. She calls $$バサラ$$ '$$アニマスピリチア$$' and takes an interest in him. Besides flight and Spiritia absorption, she can emit energy waves and even possess humans. When possessing someone, the means of absorbing Spiritia becomes kissing. In the main story she possessed $$アキコ$$ and kissed the people of $$シティ７$$ one after another. Incidentally, she can freely choose whether the host's own ego remains during possession.
Hearing $$バサラ$$'s song throws her into a kind of ecstatic state.
In the end, sympathizing with $$バサラ$$, she sang 'TRY AGAIN' together with $$バサラ$$ toward $$ゲペルニッチ$$ and evolved into a race that regenerates Spiritia by itself.
fixes.reason: pro-drop/pronoun: Sivil is female (girl-type, wiki); subjects dropped, the literal name 'Sivil' repeated, and 自我の有無は自由である (the entry lists her abilities) rendered as an agentless 'optional'

A $$プロトデビルン$$ obsessed with beauty.
He is distinguished by a whole body covered in fluffy fur. When he merges with $$グラビル$$ and returns to his original form, the fur hardens, and feather-like growths sprout on the $$グラビル$$ part as well.
He has a distinctive way of speaking, attaching 'beauty' to compound words, as in 'revenge-beauty' and 'struggle-beauty'.
A loyal subordinate of $$ゲペルニッチ$$, quick-witted and resourceful, he worked as an entirely satisfactory right-hand man.
Besides abilities such as flight, Spiritia absorption and possessing humans, he also showed first-rate piloting technique, and fought several deadly battles against $$ダイヤモンドフォース$$ and others. When his Spiritia is drained, his skin becomes wrinkled and mummy-like.
Incidentally, he gets along extremely badly with every $$プロトデビルン$$ other than $$ゲペルニッチ$$.
After obtaining a means of regenerating Spiritia, he set off for another galaxy together with $$ゲペルニッチ$$ and the others.
